description: A date N days / business days / weeks / months / years after a date. Calendar periods follow the Interpretation Law 1981 s.10: the start day is not counted, month periods end on the same day number (or the last day of a shorter month), and a period whose last day is a rest day ends on the next day that is not. A specific law, court rules or a contract can set another rule; not legal advice.
